facts.summary: Injection site reactions pause DT-216 dosing; multi-dose study resumes H2 2024 with new formulation · Phase 1 · DT-216 in Friedreich ataxia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The company is now conducting bridging nonclinical studies to resume clinical development and expects to begin a multiple-dose Phase 1 clinical trial in the second half of 2024 with initial data expected in the first half of 2025.
evidence.safety: DT-216 was generally well-tolerated. Injection site reactions associated with the formulation excipients, were observed across dose cohorts.
evidence.program_discontinued: The Phase 1 findings support the continued development of DT-216 and Design plans to explore the full potential of FXN restoration with an improved formulation
